messages:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV-2 — elevated OOMs and 5xx rate from kv-cache processes in prod-us-west1. Alert group: kv-cache/continuous-batching. Trigger: 80% increase in OOMs over 15m. Auto-escalate to oncall

alex: Ack. I'm oncall for infra tonight. grabbing logs and p99 graphs. linking: https://dash.internal/observability/kv-cache?range=15m

emma: seeing contiguous allocation failures in arena allocator logs. lots of small free/alloc churn. suspect fragmentation after yesterday's batch config roll (batch_size_min=4 -> 8).

raj: that config was rolled to 25% canary at 03:10UTC. Can confirm a correlation: batching jump -> larger KV cache growth per request -> more slab churn.

lina: also seeing higher average sequence length on those requests (customers using long-context prompts). More KV entries kept longer.

alex: tagging support and CS. @jess @maya can you surface whether any customers opened tickets?

jess: support: three customers reported intermittent 500s in the last hour, all in us-west1. CS notified. No P0 yet but several requests time out and retry.

sam: quick health check commands for the affected hosts:
```
# on a runtime host
ps aux | grep kv_runtime
pmap <pid> | tail -n 20
sudo cat /var/log/kv/arena.log | tail -n 200
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv
```
I've pulled heap histograms from two hosts, fragmentation ratios ~0.42 -> high.

emma: logs showing repeated small allocations failing and falling back to cudaMalloc, causing spikes. snippet: 
```
[ERROR] allocator.cc:372 allocation failed 4096 bytes, arena_free_space=8KB, fallback to cudaMalloc
[WARN] kv_cache.cc:128 eviction could not reclaim contiguous slab, fragmentation=0.43
```

raj: mitigation plan: 1) immediately roll back batch_size_min to previous value on canary and pause rollout; 2) trigger aggressive compaction on least-loaded shards; 3) increase arena_reslice trigger threshold to force coalescing; 4) soft-restart subset of runtimes to force arena compaction during warm-up; 5) monitor errors.

alex: executing 1) now. Rolling feature flag rollback to batch_size_min=4 for canary (FF id ff/2026/kv-batch-tuning).

(2 minutes later)
alex: rollback accepted, canary reverted. Observability shows initial drop in OOMs but still elevated.

emma: running compaction script on a small subset: `scripts/compactors/force_compact.sh --shard us-west1-a --limit 5`. Command output: 
```
compaction: shard=us-west1-a started
compaction: reclaimed 150MiB in 5 episodes
compaction: fragmentation now 0.31
```

lina: increased arena_reslice threshold from 0.4 -> 0.25 temporarily via runtime config: `runtime.cfg.arena_reslice_fraction=0.25` on canary group.

sam: soft-restarting 10% of kv-runtime pods in the us-west1 ASG (rolling) to ensure arenas get rebuilt under new params. Command: `kubectl rollout restart ds/kv-runtime -l shard=us-west1 -n prod --field-selector=spec.nodeName=<node>` (targeted).

raj: also applied a temporary allocator patch in staging that reduces reliance on cudaMalloc for tiny fallbacks (limits per-thread cudaMalloc retries). Preparing cherry-pick for prod if needed.

alex: early impact assessment: overall error rate dropped from 5.1% -> 2.8% across the region after rollback+compaction. Still above baseline (0.6%). Affected customer count reduced to ~12 active tenants hitting long-context routes.

jess: CS notified affected customers with ETA ~2h for full remediation and explanation of rollback. They asked for a root-cause summary once available.

lina: collecting KV entry lifetime histograms and per-request KV growth traces to validate whether long sequences are root cause or if fragmentation alone explains it.

emma: note: fragmentation seems to have a per-host variance. One host recovered to fragmentation=0.19 after compaction+restart, another remains ~0.34. Likely due to allocation patterns and hot keys.

raj: propose follow-ups: - revert batch change (complete pause) until we model sequence-length distribution; - add proactive compaction schedule after batch config changes; - instrument per-route kv-growth in prod; - land allocator fix to avoid small-cuda fallbacks.

alex: agreed. Escalating to release manager: pause global rollout. @release-team please hold.

sam: for immediate customer protection we can also apply a temporary rate limit on long-context routes on us-west1, configured via the routing layer: `rate_limit: routes:/v1/generate/long-context -> 30r/s` until fully stable.

jess: implementing the rate limit with CS-approved message. Will post update to customers.

(45 minutes in)
alex: handing off to night SRE shift. Summary for next oncall: we've paused batch_size_min rollout, forced compaction on a subset of shards, adjusted arena_reslice fraction down, soft restarted a rolling subset of runtimes, and implemented temporary rate limits for long-context routes. Error rate trending down but still above baseline. Customer impact limited to retries/timeouts for ~12 tenants. Suspected root cause: increased per-request kv allocations combined with micro-fragmentation from new batching behavior causing more fallback cudaMallocs.

alex: Handoff checklist:
- logs & links: https://dash.internal/observability/kv-cache?range=3h
- compaction script: scripts/compactors/force_compact.sh
- rollback action: FF ff/2026/kv-batch-tuning (rollback applied to canary at 03:22UTC)
- config changed: runtime.cfg.arena_reslice_fraction=0.25 on canary; consider applying wider if stable
- outstanding: land allocator change PR #4832 (raj) and run full shard compaction next maintenance window

emma: leaving tail of relevant logs here for triage: 
```
host=kv-prod-12 arena_frag=0.34 evict_tries=3 fallback_to_cuda=1
host=kv-prod-07 arena_frag=0.19 evict_tries=1 fallback_to_cuda=0
```

raj: PR #4832 link: https://git.internal/redwood/kv-runtime/pull/4832 (small-change: limit_per_thread_cuda_retries + improved free-list coalescing). Landing condition: perf tests + one-day canary.

maya: CS: I'll update affected customers with the rollback note and estimated timeline for the allocator fix.

alex: leaving the channel. Night SRE, please pick this up and escalate to infra on-call if OOMs rebound above 4% region-wide.

emma: ACK. I'll keep a 30m watch and report back.

incident-bot: Incident note recorded: 2166001234. Current severity SEV-2 -> monitoring.

(End of thread)
